title: MED-COREASONER: Reducing Language Disparities in Medical Reasoning via Language-Informed Co-Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing model accuracy, completeness, and safety on medical question-answering and natural language inference benchmarks (e.g., MultiMed-X, Global-MMLU) across a diverse set of high-resource and low-resource languages (e.g., English, Swahili, Yoruba, Zulu).

Conducting blinded expert human evaluations using pairwise comparisons to assess the 'Localization' and 'Local Clinical Naturalness' of generated medical reasoning, specifically measuring its alignment with regional medical practices, guidelines, and terminology.
